posts.title: PhysCodeGym: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Physically Verifiable 4D Reconstruction
posts.description: PhysCodeGym (Shanghai Jiao Tong University and others) asks coding agents to rebuild 156 videos as Blender programs and checks them physically. What it measures, what it found, and how to run it in Real2SimLab.

posts.title: PhySimCode: A Benchmark and Evaluation Method for Physics Video to Code Generation
posts.description: PhySimCode (Carnegie Mellon University, Amazon AGI) asks a model to infer the physics of a video and write code that regenerates it. What it measures, what it found, and how to run it in Real2SimLab.

posts.title: Video2World: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Interactive World Modeling from Embodied Videos
posts.description: Video2World (Aether AI, UC San Diego) asks coding agents to turn an embodied video into an interactive simulated world. What it measures, what it found, and how to run it in Real2SimLab.

posts.title: 4DCodeBench: Benchmarking Agents on Inverse Graphics of Dynamic Scenes
posts.description: 4DCodeBench (Johns Hopkins, Stanford, MPI-IS, MIT) asks agents to rebuild a video of a dynamic scene as an executable 4D graphics program. What it measures, what it found, and how to run it in Real2SimLab.

posts.title: IRIS: A Real-World Benchmark for Inverse Recovery and Identification of Physical Dynamic Systems from Monocular Video
posts.description: IRIS (Hamad Bin Khalifa University, Texas A&M) records 240 real 4K videos of eight dynamical systems with measured parameters. What it measures, what it found, and how to run it in Real2SimLab.

posts.title: Physics-IQ: Do Generative Video Models Understand Physical Principles?
posts.description: Physics-IQ (Google DeepMind) films 66 physical events twice from three views and asks a model to predict how each continues. What it measures, what it found, and how to run it in Real2SimLab.

posts.title: 3DCodeVerse: Exploring 3D Worlds as Code
posts.description: 3DCodeVerse (University of Southern California and others) gives coding agents a dataset of executable 3D programs and a harness that checks and refines what they build. How it works and what the paper found.

posts.title: Agentic Real2Sim: Physics-based World Modeling with Vision-Language Agents
posts.description: Agentic Real2Sim (University of British Columbia and others) uses vision-language agents to convert robot recordings into simulatable MuJoCo episode twins. How it works and what the paper found.
